gameDescriptionHtml:
A 90’s nostalgia inspired lo-fi adventure with a relaxing atmosphere and wholesome story, paced between tiny planet platforming and puzzle-solving.

In Astro Pig you play as Buyk, a piglet space cadet, on a mysterious mission through uncharted territory together with his intelligent ship – talk with the galaxy sector’s inhabitants, solve challenges to open up new paths and help him find what he’s looking for.

Game Features

  • Explore three different worlds with dozens of stages and many puzzle mechanics;
  • Talk with many different NPCs in a lighthearted, quirky dialogue style;
  • Unlock three retro addictive minigames for your handheld console;
  • Get Steam Achievements
  • Listen to over 40 completely original lo-fi tracks
  • And make your own tracks with our Make-a-Beat system!
